		v103 = v103 + v104
	end
	local v105 = #v102
	return v103 / math.max(1, v105)
end

function v_u_4.GetTrail(p122) -- name: GetTrail
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_121
	if not p122 or p122 < 1 then
		return nil
	end
	if v_u_4.Trails[p122] then
		return v_u_4.Trails[p122]
	end
	if #v_u_4.Trails < p122 then
		return nil
	end
	local v123 = v_u_4.Trails[(p122 - 1) % #v_u_4.Trails + 1]
	local v124 = (p122 - 1) / #v_u_4.Trails
	local v125 = math.floor(v124) + 1
	local v126 = v_u_4.Trails[#v_u_4.Trails]
	local v127 = {
		["Name"] = v123.Name .. " " .. (v_u_121[v125] or tostring(v125)),
		["Colors"] = v123.Colors,
		["Rainbow"] = v123.Rainbow
	}
	local v128 = v126.Cost * v_u_4.Infinite.TrailCostGrowth ^ (p122 - #v_u_4.Trails)
	v127.Cost = math.floor(v128)
	v127.Mult = v126.Mult + v_u_4.Infinite.TrailMultPerTier * (p122 - #v_u_4.Trails)
	v127.Speed = (v126.Speed or 0) + (p122 - #v_u_4.Trails)
	return v127
end
function v_u_4.GetBarbell(p129) -- name: GetBarbell
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_121
	if v_u_4.Barbells[p129] then
		return v_u_4.Barbells[p129]
	end
	if (p129 or 0) > #v_u_4.Barbells then
		return nil
	end
	local v130 = v_u_4.Barbells[#v_u_4.Barbells]
	local v131 = p129 - #v_u_4.Barbells
	local v132 = {}
	local v133 = v130.Name
	local v134 = v131 + 1
	v132.Name = v133 .. " " .. (v_u_121[v134] or tostring(v134))
	local v135 = v130.Color
	local v136 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	local v137 = v131 * 0.1
	v132.Color = v135:Lerp(v136, (math.min(0.6, v137)))
	local v138 = v130.Cost * v_u_4.Infinite.BarbellCostGrowth ^ v131
	v132.Cost = math.floor(v138)
	local v139 = v130.Gain * v_u_4.Infinite.BarbellGainGrowth ^ v131
	v132.Gain = math.floor(v139)
	return v132
end
function v_u_4.PenCost(p140) -- name: PenCost
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_4
	if p140 <= v_u_4.Pen.Start then
		return nil
	end
	if v_u_4.Pen.Costs[p140] then
		return v_u_4.Pen.Costs[p140]
	end
	local v141 = v_u_4.Pen.Costs[v_u_4.Pen.Max] * v_u_4.Infinite.PenCostGrowth ^ (p140 - v_u_4.Pen.Max)
	return math.floor(v141)
end

function v_u_4.SpeciesCount(p142, p143) -- name: SpeciesCount
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_4
	local v144 = v_u_4.Biomes[p142]
	local v145 = v144 and v144.Species
	if v145 then
		v145 = v144.Species[p143]
	end
	return v145 and #v145 or 1
end
function v_u_4.PetName(p146, p147, p148) -- name: PetName
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_4
	local v149 = v_u_4.Biomes[p146]
	if not v149 then
		return "Pet"
	end
	local v150 = v149.Species
	if v150 then
		v150 = v149.Species[p147]
	end
	if not v150 then
		return v149.Pets and v149.Pets[p147] or "Pet"
	end
	local v151 = #v150
	return v150[math.clamp(p148 or 1, 1, v151)]
end
function v_u_4.PetList(p152) -- name: PetList
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_4
	local v153 = v_u_4.Biomes[p152]
	local v154 = {}
	for v155 = 1, v153 and v153.MaxRarity or #v_u_4.Rarities do
		if v153 and (v153.Premium or (v153.ShopEgg or v153.SkipEmptyRarities)) and not (v153.Species and v153.Species[v155]) then
			continue
		end
		for v156 = 1, v_u_4.SpeciesCount(p152, v155) do
			local v157 = {
				["Rarity"] = v155,
				["Species"] = v156,
				["Name"] = v_u_4.PetName(p152, v155, v156)
			}
			table.insert(v154, v157)
		end
	end
	return v154
end

	local v167 = {}
	local v168 = 0
	for v169, v170 in ipairs(p166) do
		if v170.Rest then
			continue
		end
		v167[v169] = v170.Chance
		v168 = v168 + v170.Chance
	end
	for v171, v172 in ipairs(p166) do
		if not v172.Rest then
			continue
		end
		local v173 = 1 - v168
		v167[v171] = math.max(0, v173)
	end
	return v167
end

function v_u_4.Short(p188) -- name: Short
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_187
	local v189 = tonumber(p188) or 0
	local v190 = v189 < 0
	local v191 = math.abs(v189)
	local v192 = 1
	while v191 >= 999.95 and v192 < #v_u_187 do
		v191 = v191 / 1000
		v192 = v192 + 1
	end
	local v193
	if v192 == 1 then
		v193 = v191 % 1 ~= 0 and v191 < 100 and string.format("%.1f", v191):gsub("%.0$", "")
		if not v193 then
			local v194 = math.floor(v191)
			v193 = tostring(v194)
		end
	else
		v193 = (v191 >= 100 and string.format("%d", v191) or string.format("%.1f", v191)):gsub("%.0$", "")
	end
	return (v190 and "-" or "") .. v193 .. v_u_187[v192]
end

v_u_4.JumpKneeJump = 195
v_u_4.JumpSlopeLate = 10
v_u_4.MaxJump = 220
v_u_4.JumpDripPerDoubling = 0.01
v_u_4.JumpDripMax = 0.06
v_u_4.MaxSpeed = 150

local v207 = v_u_4.JumpKneeJump
v_u_4.KneeStrength = v207 <= 50 and 0 or v_u_4.JumpK * (10 ^ ((v207 - 50) / v_u_4.JumpSlope) - 1)
v_u_4.CapStrength = v_u_4.KneeStrength * 10 ^ ((v_u_4.MaxJump - v_u_4.JumpKneeJump) / v_u_4.JumpSlopeLate)
function v_u_4.JumpPower(p208) -- name: JumpPower
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_4
	local v209 = tonumber(p208) or 0
	local v210 = math.max(0, v209)
	if v210 <= v_u_4.KneeStrength then
		local v211 = v_u_4.JumpSlope
		local v212 = 1 + math.max(0, v210) / v_u_4.JumpK
		return 50 + v211 * math.log10(v212)
	end
	if v210 <= v_u_4.CapStrength then
		local v213 = v_u_4.JumpKneeJump
		local v214 = v_u_4.JumpSlopeLate
		local v215 = v210 / v_u_4.KneeStrength
		return v213 + v214 * math.log10(v215)
	end
	local v216 = v_u_4.JumpDripMax
	local v217 = v_u_4.JumpDripPerDoubling
	local v218 = v210 / v_u_4.CapStrength
	local v219 = v217 * math.log(v218, 2)
	local v220 = math.min(v216, v219)
	local v221 = v_u_4.MaxJump
	local v222 = v220 + 1
	return v221 * math.sqrt(v222)
end
function v_u_4.StrengthForJump(p223) -- name: StrengthForJump
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_4
	if p223 <= 50 then
		return 0
	end
	if p223 <= v_u_4.JumpKneeJump then
		local v224 = p223 <= 50 and 0 or v_u_4.JumpK * (10 ^ ((p223 - 50) / v_u_4.JumpSlope) - 1)
		return math.ceil(v224)
	end
	if p223 <= v_u_4.MaxJump then
		local v225 = v_u_4.KneeStrength * 10 ^ ((p223 - v_u_4.JumpKneeJump) / v_u_4.JumpSlopeLate)
		return math.ceil(v225)
	end
	local v226 = v_u_4.JumpDripMax
	local v227 = (p223 / v_u_4.MaxJump) ^ 2 - 1
	local v228 = math.min(v226, v227)
	local v229 = v_u_4.CapStrength * 2 ^ (v228 / v_u_4.JumpDripPerDoubling)
	return math.ceil(v229)
end
local v_u_230 = v_u_4.SquatSpeed
function v_u_4.SquatSpeed(p231) -- name: SquatSpeed
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_230
	local v232 = tonumber(p231) or 0
	local v233 = math.max(0, v232)
	local v234 = v_u_230(v233)
	local v235 = v233 / 6000 + 1
	local v236 = math.log10(v235) * 6
	return math.min(v234, v236)
end
function v_u_4.RebirthTrainMult(p237) -- name: RebirthTrainMult
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_4
	return 1 + v_u_4.RebirthTrainPer * math.max(0, p237 or 0)
end
function v_u_4.TrainMult(p238, p239, p240) -- name: TrainMult
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_4
	return (v_u_4.TrailMult(p238) + math.max(1, p239 or 1) - 1) * v_u_4.RebirthTrainMult(p240)
end

	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_241, (ref) v_u_242
	if v_u_241 and os.clock() - v_u_242 < 3 then
		return v_u_241
	end
	local v243 = workspace:FindFirstChild("Zones")
	local v244 = {}
	local v245 = -40
	for _, v246 in ipairs(v243 and v243:GetChildren() or {}) do
		local v247 = v246:GetAttribute("ZStart")
		local v248 = v246:GetAttribute("ZEnd")
		if not (v247 and v248) then
			continue
		end
		local v249 = { v247, v248, v246:GetAttribute("HalfWidth") or 60 }
		table.insert(v244, v249)
		if v248 >= v245 then
			continue
		end
		v245 = v248
	end
	local v250 = os.clock()
	v_u_241 = {
		["Zones"] = v244,
		["EndZ"] = v245
	}
	v_u_242 = v250
	return v_u_241
end

			continue
		end

	end

end

	return v261, v261 * v_u_4.Bands.Early, v256
end

function v_u_4.RewardText(p288, p289, p290) -- name: RewardText
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_4
	if not p288.Hours then
		if not p288.IncomeHours then
			return p288.Title, v_u_4.RewardSub(p288)
		end
		local v291 = "$" .. v_u_4.Short(v_u_4.IncomeCash(p288, p290)) .. " CASH"
		local v292
		if p288.NoSub then
			v292 = nil
		else
			local v293 = p288.IncomeHours
			local v294
			if v293 >= 1 then
				v294 = "(" .. v293 .. (v293 == 1 and " HOUR)" or " HOURS)")
			else
				local v295 = v293 * 60 + 0.5
				v294 = "(" .. math.floor(v295) .. " MIN)"
			end
			v292 = v294 or nil
		end
		return v291, v292
	end

end

end

function v_u_4.MutList(p349) -- name: MutList
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_4
	local v350 = {}

		end
	end
	return v350
end

v_u_4.LevelTime = {
	["Early"] = 8,
	["EarlyGrowth"] = 1.1,
	["Mid"] = 10,
	["Target"] = 300,
	["TargetLevel"] = 15,
	["LateGrowth"] = 1.06,
	["MaxSeconds"] = 7200,
	["PerMutation"] = 0.5

function v_u_4.LevelSeconds(p361) -- name: LevelSeconds
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_4
	local v362 = v_u_4.LevelTime
	if p361 <= v362.Mid then
		return v362.Early * v362.EarlyGrowth ^ (p361 - 1)
	end
	local v363 = v362.Early * v362.EarlyGrowth ^ (v362.Mid - 1)
	if p361 <= v362.TargetLevel then
		return v363 * (v362.Target / v363) ^ ((p361 - v362.Mid) / (v362.TargetLevel - v362.Mid))
	end
	local v364 = v362.MaxSeconds
	local v365 = v362.Target * v362.LateGrowth ^ (p361 - v362.TargetLevel)
	return math.min(v364, v365)
end
function v_u_4.LevelCostFor(p366, p367) -- name: LevelCostFor
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_4
	local v368 = v_u_4.CleanLevel(p367 or p366.Level)
	if p366.Biome == "Reward" or not v_u_4.Biomes[p366.Biome] then
		return v_u_4.LevelCost(v368, v_u_4.PetBaseIncome(p366))
	end
	local v369 = v_u_4.EggValue(p366.Biome, p366.Rarity, p366.Size or 3, p366.Mutation, p366.Species) * v_u_4.LevelMult(v368)
	local v370 = 1 + v_u_4.MutBonus(p366.Muts)
	local v371 = p366.Lucky
	local v372 = v369 * (v370 + (tonumber(v371) or 0))
	local v373 = #v_u_4.MutList(p366.Muts) + (v_u_4.GetMutation(p366.Mutation, p366.Biome) and 1 or 0)
	local v374 = math.max(v372, 0.01) * v_u_4.LevelSeconds(v368) * (1 + v_u_4.LevelTime.PerMutation * v373)
	return math.ceil(v374)
end

function v_u_4.SpinChance(p406) -- name: SpinChance
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_4
	local v407 = 0
	for _, v408 in ipairs(v_u_4.SpinWheel.Rewards) do
		v407 = v407 + v408.Weight
	end
	return v_u_4.SpinWheel.Rewards[p406].Weight / v407
end
function v_u_4.GravityCeiling() -- name: GravityCeiling
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_4
	local v409 = v_u_4.MaxJump
	local v410 = type(v409) == "number" and v_u_4.MaxJump or 220
	return v410 * v410 / 392.4 * (1 + (v_u_4.Abuse.GravityOver or 0.1))
end
function v_u_4.GravityCapJump() -- name: GravityCapJump
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_4
	local v411 = 392.4 * (v_u_4.Abuse.GravityMult or 0.3) * v_u_4.GravityCeiling()
	return math.sqrt(v411)
end
function v_u_4.GravityJump(p412) -- name: GravityJump
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_4
	local v413 = v_u_4.Abuse.GravityMult or 0.3
	local v414 = v_u_4.GravityCeiling()
	local v415 = p412 * p412 / 392.4 / v413 / v414
	local v416 = v414 * math.tanh(v415)
	local v417 = 392.4 * v413 * v416
	return math.sqrt(v417)
end

local function v_u_19(p10) -- name: seq
	if typeof(p10) == "Color3" then
		return ColorSequence.new(p10)
	end
	if #p10 == 1 then
		return ColorSequence.new(p10[1])
	end
	local v11 = {}
	for v12, v13 in ipairs(p10) do
		if typeof(v13) == "table" then
			local v14 = ColorSequenceKeypoint.new
			local v15 = v13[2]
			local v16 = v13[1]
			table.insert(v11, v14(v15, v16))
		else
			local v17 = ColorSequenceKeypoint.new
			local v18 = (v12 - 1) / (#p10 - 1)
			table.insert(v11, v17(v18, v13))
		end
	end
	return ColorSequence.new(v11)
end
v_u_3.seq = v_u_19

	v29.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	v29.ZIndex = p_u_23.ZIndex
	v29.Parent = p_u_23
	local v30 = Instance.new("UICorner")

	v30.Parent = v29
	local v_u_31 = Instance.new("UIGradient")
	v_u_31.Rotation = 90
	v_u_31.Parent = v29
	local function v48() -- name: set
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_23, (copy) p_u_25, (copy) p_u_24, (copy) v_u_31, (copy) p_u_27
		local v32 = p_u_23.AbsoluteSize.Y
		local v33 = p_u_25 / math.max(1, v32)
		local v34 = math.clamp(v33, 0.001, 0.998)
		if p_u_24 then
			local v35 = v_u_31
			local v36 = NumberSequence.new
			local v37 = {}
			local v38 = NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1 - p_u_27)
			local v39 = NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(v34, 1 - p_u_27)
			local v40 = NumberSequenceKeypoint.new
			local v41 = v34 + 0.001
			__set_list(v37, 1, {v38, v39, v40(math.min(0.999, v41), 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)})
			v35.Transparency = v36(v37)
		else
			local v42 = v_u_31
			local v43 = NumberSequence.new
			local v44 = {}
			local v45 = NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1)
			local v46 = NumberSequenceKeypoint.new
			local v47 = 1 - v34 - 0.001
			__set_list(v44, 1, {v45, v46(math.max(0.001, v47), 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1 - v34, 1 - p_u_27), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1 - p_u_27)})
			v42.Transparency = v43(v44)
		end
	end
	v48()
	p_u_23:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(v48)

end

function v_u_2.Remove(p258, p259) -- name: Remove
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2
	for _, v260 in ipairs(p258:GetDescendants()) do
		if v260.Name:sub(1, 7) ~= "MutVFX_" or p259 and v260.Name ~= "MutVFX_" .. (v_u_2.ForMutation[p259] or p259) then
			continue
		end
		v260:Destroy()
	end
end
function v_u_2.Apply(p261, p262) -- name: Apply
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_73, (copy) v_u_39
	local v263 = v_u_2.ForMutation[p262] or p262
	local v264 = v_u_73[v263]
	if not (v264 and p261) then
		return false
	end
	v_u_2.Remove(p261, v263)
	local v265, v266, v267 = v_u_39(p261)
	if not v265 then
		return false
	end
	local v268 = v267.X
	local v269 = v267.Y
	local v270 = v267.Z
	local v271 = math.max(v268, v269, v270) / 3
	if v271 > 1 then
		v271 = v271 ^ 0.8 or v271
	end
	v264(v265, v266, v267, v271, v_u_2.Textures[v263] or {})
	for _, v272 in ipairs(v265:GetDescendants()) do
		if v272.Name ~= "MutVFX_" .. v263 then
			continue
		end
		for _, v273 in ipairs(v272:GetDescendants()) do
			if v273:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
				v273.LightEmission = v273.LightEmission * 0.45
				local v274 = v273.Brightness
				v273.Brightness = math.min(v274, 1) * 0.85
				local v275 = {}

					local v277 = NumberSequenceKeypoint.new

					local v279 = 1 - (1 - v276.Value) * 0.7
					local v280 = v276.Envelope
					table.insert(v275, v277(v278, v279, v280))
				end
				v273.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(v275)

end

				local v183 = 1 - (1 - v182) ^ 4

				v174.Rotation = v184
				local v185
				if p173 then

			end
		end

function resetManagerListeners() -- name: resetManagerListeners

	if v_u_20 then

		v_u_21 = nil

		v_u_22 = nil
	end
end
function teardownManager() -- name: teardownManager
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_23, (ref) v_u_24
	resetManagerListeners()
	v_u_23 = nil
	v_u_24 = nil
end
function processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_28) -- name: processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_24, (ref) v_u_23, (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_21, (ref) v_u_22
	if p_u_28.RootPart ~= v_u_1.PrimaryPart then
		return false
	end
	if v_u_24 ~= p_u_28 then
		resetManagerListeners()
		v_u_23 = p_u_28.GroundSensor
		v_u_20 = p_u_28:GetPropertyChangedSignal("GroundSensor"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_28, (ref) v_u_20
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_28) then
				v_u_20:Disconnect()
				v_u_20 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_21 = p_u_28:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_28, (ref) v_u_21
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_28) then
				v_u_21:Disconnect()
				v_u_21 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_22 = p_u_28.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, p29)
			if p29 == nil then
				resetManagerListeners()
				lookForControllerManager()
			end
		end)
		v_u_24 = p_u_28
	end
	return true
end
function setupManager(p_u_30) -- name: setupManager
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_24, (ref) v_u_23, (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_21, (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_22
	v_u_24 = p_u_30
	v_u_23 = p_u_30.GroundSensor
	v_u_20 = p_u_30:GetPropertyChangedSignal("GroundSensor"):Connect(function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_23, (ref) v_u_24
		v_u_23 = v_u_24.GroundSensor
	end)
	v_u_21 = p_u_30:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_30, (ref) v_u_1
		if p_u_30.RootPart ~= v_u_1.PrimaryPart then
			teardownManager()
			lookForControllerManager()
		end
	end)
	v_u_22 = p_u_30.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, p31)
		if p31 == nil then
			teardownManager()
			lookForControllerManager()
		end
	end)
end
function lookForControllerManager() -- name: lookForControllerManager
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_27, (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_23, (ref) v_u_24
	if v_u_27 then
		local v_u_32 = v_u_1:FindFirstChildOfClass("ControllerManager")
		if v_u_32 then
			if v_u_32.RootPart == v_u_1.PrimaryPart then
				setupManager(v_u_32)
			else
				local v_u_33 = nil
				v_u_33 = v_u_32:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
					-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_32, (ref) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_33
					if v_u_32.RootPart == v_u_1.PrimaryPart then
						v_u_33:Disconnect()
						setupManager(v_u_32)
					end
				end)
			end
		else
			local v_u_34 = nil
			v_u_34 = v_u_1.ChildAdded:Connect(function(p35)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_34
				if p35:IsA("ControllerManager") then
					v_u_34:Disconnect()
					lookForControllerManager()
				end
			end)
			return
		end
	else
		v_u_23 = nil
		v_u_24 = nil
		local v36 = v_u_1:FindFirstChildOfClass("ControllerManager")
		if v36 then
			processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(v36)
		end
		if v_u_24 == nil then
			local v_u_37 = nil
			v_u_37 = v_u_1.ChildAdded:Connect(function(p38)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_37
				if p38:IsA("ControllerManager") and processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p38) then
					v_u_37:Disconnect()
					v_u_37 = nil
				end
			end)
		end
		return
	end
end

function getHeightScale() -- name: getHeightScale
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_4, (ref) v_u_5
	if not v_u_2 then
		return v_u_4()
	end
	if not v_u_2.AutomaticScalingEnabled then
		return v_u_4()
	end
	local v102 = v_u_2.HipHeight / 2
	if v_u_5 == nil then
		v_u_5 = script:FindFirstChild("ScaleDampeningPercent")
	end
	if v_u_5 ~= nil then
		v102 = 1 + (v_u_2.HipHeight - 2) * v_u_5.Value / 2
	end
	return v102
end
local function v_u_108(p103) -- name: setRunSpeed
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_11, (ref) v_u_14
	local v104 = p103 * 1.25 / getHeightScale()
	local v105 = 0.0001
	local v106 = 0.0001
	local v107 = 1
	if v104 <= 0.5 then
		v107 = v104 / 0.5
		v105 = 1
	elseif v104 < 1 then
		v106 = (v104 - 0.5) / 0.5
		v105 = 1 - v106
	else
		v107 = v104 / 1
		v106 = 1
	end
	v_u_11:AdjustWeight(v105)
	v_u_14:AdjustWeight(v106)
	v_u_11:AdjustSpeed(v107)
	v_u_14:AdjustSpeed(v107)
end

function rollAnimation(p114) -- name: rollAnimation
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_17
	local v115 = math.random(1, v_u_17[p114].totalWeight)
	local v116 = 1
	while v_u_17[p114][v116].weight < v115 do
		v115 = v115 - v_u_17[p114][v116].weight

	end
	return v116
end
